title: Parklet and accessible clear-width pilot — Chapel St north
powers: Permit conditions under cl.126 and the Footpath Trading Policy — no change to the law needed to run it.
hypothesis: A permanent parklet class with a 1.8m continuous accessible path can be delivered without reducing trader participation.
measure: Accessible-path compliance audited monthly; trader participation; complaint volume; Disability Advisory Committee assessment at close.

title: E-scooter parking corrals and footpath clearance
powers: Operator agreement plus obstruction powers under cl.127. Tests the drafting before it is written.
hypothesis: Mandatory corral parking cuts footpath obstruction reports by more than half without displacing trips.
measure: Obstruction reports per 1,000 trips; corral compliance rate; audit of clear width at 20 fixed points.

title: Cat containment — voluntary phase and education
powers: Education and voluntary registration only. A containment requirement itself needs the new law.
hypothesis: Voluntary uptake and the shape of the objections tell us whether a curfew or full containment is deliverable.
measure: Voluntary sign-ups; cat-related requests; wildlife reports; a structured record of objection themes for the drafting file.

title: Amplified music compliance — Prahran and Windsor late night
powers: Monitoring and voluntary agreements with operators under existing cl.144.
hypothesis: Speaker placement rules do more work than the 65dB number, and a placement-first standard is easier to enforce.
measure: Paired measurements at facade and source; complaints per venue; officer time per matter.

title: Nature strip planting — self-assessment approval
powers: Administrative approval pathway under the existing Nature Strip Planting Policy.
hypothesis: A self-assessment checklist can replace individual approvals without increasing sightline or service-asset incidents.
measure: Applications processed; non-compliant plantings found on audit; asset-strike incidents; processing time per application.

title: Extended building hours in exchange for a construction management plan
powers: Consent conditions on asset protection permits under cl.115.
hypothesis: Traded extended hours plus a named community liaison reduce total disruption compared with the current fixed hours.
measure: Complaints per site per week against matched control sites; number of hour breaches; builder take-up.

title: Kerbside EV charging and footpath cable covers
powers: Trial permit with conditions, treating the cable as a permitted obstruction under cl.127.
hypothesis: A conditional permit with an approved cable cover is a workable alternative to prohibition for homes without off-street parking.
measure: Trip-hazard incidents; insurance and liability assessment; participant and passer-by feedback; cost per permit.
